# TAPG.JK — cooldown-expiry re-test, still fails on evidence

Signal / why now: NEGLECTED #7 / MOMENTUM #6 at Rp1,850. The 30-day cooldown from the 2026-10-12 kill expires today, and the deferred 11-09 note asked for a re-test rather than a re-file.

**Why DISCARD.** This is not a cheaper revisit of either kill: at 1,850 it is +1.1% ABOVE the 2026-08-19 valuation kill at 1,830 and only −8% below the 10-12 kill at 2,010. The only bull anchor is the house model (BUY, TP Rp2,839.7, +48.7%), and that report is stage `parked`, v0, round 3 — two QC passes and one sector-lead re-open — so it is not published house coverage and cannot carry a step-4b card.

The payout is the kill: dividend Rp201/sh is ~142% of FY25 FCF (Rp3.99tn vs 2.81tn) on 32–34% net margins, at 9.9x trailing earnings and 3.2x book (ROE 36%). FCF is 2.7x net income, so the cash is real — the problem is a payout policy that outruns it, which makes the 10.1% yield a melting-ice-cube risk precisely when CPO prices roll over.

Fast-disqualify: registry EV at `neglected_midcap_discovery` (0.44/+55/−30/2.5y) = +7.4% over 2.5y, +2.9%/yr — positive but under the IDR hurdle ✓/✗. Valuation anchor exists only in an unpublishable draft ✗. Sources reachable ✓. Two of three, with the anchor inadmissible → DISCARD, revisit only if the report is published or the payout is reset to ≤FCF.
